title: Hearty Malty Spanish Chinese Broccoli Ensaimada
description: A malty, silky, adventurous Spanish dish featuring Chinese broccoli, steamed to perfection in a cast-iron skillet, ovo-vegetarian-friendly and formed into an ensaimada.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together malt syrup, olive oil, garlic, onion, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Chinese broccoli to the bowl and toss to coat with the malt syrup mixture.
Steam the Chinese broccoli mixture in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and set aside.
Roll out the ensaimada pastry dough to a large circle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spoon the steamed Chinese broccoli mixture onto one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry dough with the whisked eggs.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the ensaimada with the remaining eggs and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the ensaimada in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
